strings.zh: 奇怪？听不大清楚⋯⋯{NEWLINE}难道是电话⋯⋯坏了吗？{SCROLL}要是你有话想和我说的话,{NEWLINE}就换个地方{CLEAR}再给我打过来吧。
strings.en: What? I can’t hear you very well.{NEWLINE}I think we’ve got a bad connection.{SCROLL}Well, if you have something you want to{NEWLINE}talk to me about, go somewhere else and{CLEAR}try calling again.

strings.zh: 喂喂⋯⋯{NEWLINE}你最近怎么样？{CLEAR}我身体很好。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Hello...{NEWLINE}Oh, hi, how are you?{CLEAR}I’m doing fine, thanks.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 除了我之外还有许多{NEWLINE}厉害的馆主吧。{CLEAR}你可不要输给他们啊,{CLEAR}加油吧⋯⋯
strings.en: There are many other strong Gym{NEWLINE}Leaders besides me. Do not lose to{CLEAR}them. Give it your best...
strings.notes: US 0659/3 | RV071: meaning: no 'stronger than me' / 'I don't think you'd lose' (D-1896)

strings.zh: 我经常早起,{NEWLINE}所以找我对战的话选早上吧。{SCROLL}那么⋯⋯星期一的早上{NEWLINE}再打电话给我吧！
strings.en: I usually get up pretty early...{NEWLINE}If we’re going to battle, I’m at my best{CLEAR}in the morning... How about you give me{CLEAR}a call on Monday morning!

strings.zh: 哦,正好！{NEWLINE}我现在好无聊啊。{CLEAR}想和我再来{CLEAR}对战一场吧？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Oh, perfect timing!{NEWLINE}I was starting to get bored...{CLEAR}Do you want to battle again? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 谢谢你能这么爽快地答应！{SCROLL}我在战斗前线的{NEWLINE}训练家屋等你！
strings.en: Thank you for agreeing so readily!{SCROLL}I will be waiting for you at the{NEWLINE}Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.
strings.notes: US 0659/6 | Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 是吗？那算了。{SCROLL}等你有兴趣了{NEWLINE}再给我打电话吧。{SCROLL}但想和我战斗的话,{NEWLINE}只能在星期一早上,记住了吗？
strings.en: I see. Well, that’s how it’s got{NEWLINE}to be...{SCROLL}If you ever change your mind, give me{NEWLINE}a call.{SCROLL}Remember, I’m free on Monday mornings.

strings.zh: 你现在哪有时间{NEWLINE}和我战斗。{SCROLL}要是和其他人也预约过的话,{NEWLINE}就应该要先去解决掉{CLEAR}不是吗？
strings.en: Hmm. Do you really have the time to{NEWLINE}battle me right now?{SCROLL}If you’ve got plans with other people,{NEWLINE}you should take care of those first,{CLEAR}don’t you think?

strings.zh: 那我在战斗前线的{NEWLINE}训练家屋等你！{CLEAR}我是不会迟到的,{CLEAR}所以你放心好了！
strings.en: Then I will be waiting for you at the{NEWLINE}Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.{CLEAR}I will not be late, so rest assured!
strings.notes: US 0659/9 | Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 是我啊,柳伯。{NEWLINE}你最近怎么样？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Yes, this is Pryce.{NEWLINE}How are you doing?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 难道你忘了{NEWLINE}我们在战斗前线{CLEAR}训练家屋对战的约定了吗？{CLEAR}我等你好久了。
strings.en: Have you forgotten our promise{NEWLINE}to battle at the Trainer House{CLEAR}at the Battle Frontier? I have{CLEAR}been waiting for you a long while.
strings.notes: US 0659/11 | Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 一个如我孩子一般⋯⋯{SCROLL}不对,{SCROLL}是和我孙子差不多岁数的{NEWLINE}年轻训练师居然{CLEAR}将我打败了⋯⋯{SCROLL}但是,我并没有{NEWLINE}因此而感到懊恼,{SCROLL}反而感到有些高兴。{SCROLL}因为有才能出众的{NEWLINE}训练师出现了。{SCROLL}⋯⋯我没别的要说的了,{SCROLL}再见。
strings.en: A young Trainer about{NEWLINE}the age of my child...{SCROLL}No,{SCROLL}about the age of my{NEWLINE}grandchild, defeated me...{SCROLL}But I did not feel bitter about it.{SCROLL}If anything, I felt a little glad.{SCROLL}Because a Trainer of outstanding{NEWLINE}talent had appeared.{SCROLL}...That is all I wanted to say.{SCROLL}Goodbye.

strings.zh: 你知道我为什么会{NEWLINE}被人称作寒冬之柳么？{SCROLL}柳树虽然在冬天枯萎了,{CLEAR}但它实际上长出了很多新芽。{SCROLL}我的战斗方式也像柳树{CLEAR}一样坚强⋯⋯{SCROLL}从前的书刊上刊登过这些,{NEWLINE}你有空了可以去看看。
strings.en: Do you know why they{NEWLINE}call me the Winter Willow?{SCROLL}A willow may look withered{NEWLINE}in winter, but in truth it is{CLEAR}putting out many new buds.{SCROLL}My battle style is as{NEWLINE}hardy as the willow...{SCROLL}It was written up in old magazines.{NEWLINE}Have a look when you have time.

strings.zh: 话说,你好像阻止了{NEWLINE}火箭队的阴谋。{SCROLL}嗯⋯⋯{NEWLINE}不愧是将我打败的人,{CLEAR}这就是你的实力,{CLEAR}太精彩了。{SCROLL}看来你有很多东西{NEWLINE}值得我学习,{SCROLL}还请多多指教了⋯⋯
strings.en: That reminds me, I hear you foiled Team{NEWLINE}Rocket’s scheme. Hmm... As expected of{CLEAR}the one who defeated me. Such is your{CLEAR}strength. Splendid. It seems there is{CLEAR}much I could learn from you. I look{CLEAR}forward to learning from you...
strings.notes: US 0659/14 | RV071: meaning: praise and 'much to learn from you' restored
